attributes.name: note
attributes.value: Pupae of the tea tussock moth, E. pseudoconspersa, were collected in May 2024 from an oil-tea camellia (Camellia oleifera) plantation in Yueliangwan, Tongdao County, Huaihua City, Hunan Province, China (109.7002 E, 26.0213 N; 410 m above sea level). The host plant, developmental stage, sex, and number of collected specimens were recorded. Specimens were morphologically identified following Fauna Sinica, Insecta, Vol. 30: Lepidoptera, Lymantriidae (ISBN 978-7-03-011417-4). Species identity was further confirmed by comparing the mitochondrial cytochrome c oxidase subunit I (COI) sequence with a verified reference sequence, yielding a sequence identity of 98.7%. A voucher specimen was deposited in the Forest Insect Collection of the Hunan Academy of Forestry under accession number LEP202576043.
